protocol.references: Actual upstream AudioVAE2 full MPS on same crops; additionally original full CPU ONNX for each codec
protocol.timing: Owned CPU input through completed GPU decode and owned CPU output, including validation and synchronization; packet+flush times
protocol.exclusions: Model/session/stream construction, compilation in public load, initialization sync, close, hashing and numerical comparison. Lazy packet history allocation stays timed
protocol.boundary: Upstream and public Audio validate audio plus26 histories. Mimi wrapper validates input/audio, not all histories. All return completed CPU copies
protocol.upstream_flush: Official upstream has no flush method; a labeled empty host shim is timed, with no model call or pending audio
protocol.limitations: Two measured rounds are short evidence; no outlier removal, significance claim, or upstream-state equality claim
